title: Heavenly Punishment Warning
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao burst open the stone door of the secret chamber, only to see the horrifying scene of Chen Ji collapsed in a pool of blood, with blood seeping from his seven orifices...

text.content: That aged voice seemed to traverse endless rivers of time, carrying an indescribably complex emotion. Chen Ji slowly turned around, only to see a illusory figure floating in the middle of the secret chamber—this was the latest form of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, more solid than before, yet also more aged. His robes were covered with dense and intricate talismans, each pattern resembling a thread of destiny, tightly binding him together with the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "You have finally come, child. There are things I wished to bury forever as your father..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a long sigh, his虚幻的眼眸中闪烁着agonized与helpless交织的光芒，「但天机录的共鸣太过强烈，它已经将你引向了我。」"

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, his expression calm like still water, only the deepest part of his eyes showing a subtle wave. He did not speak, merely watching that illusory figure quietly, waiting for the other party to continue. This silence was not weakness, but acomposed of controlling the overall situation—he was waiting, waiting for the other party to reveal more底牌, waiting for the initiative of this dialogue to eventually fall into his own hands.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted closer slowly, his voice extremely low: "Chen Ji, do you know why the Tianji Record chose you? It was not because of your talent, nor your bone structure... but because the blood of Chen Xuan flows in your veins." His voice suddenly turned sharp, "Your father Chen Xuan was the previous master of the Tianji Record!"

text.content: Before the words finished, the candles in the secret chamber suddenly went out. Everything fell into deathly silence, only the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms emitting a faint green glow, casting his features in alternating light and shadow. At this moment, an indescribable sense of oppression descended from the depths of the heavens, as if an invisible eye was piercing through layers of void, firmly locking onto him.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." A majestic and cold voice exploded in the secret chamber, belonging to no one, yet seeming to come from the origin of Heavenly Way, carrying irresistible pressure.紧接着，一道血红色的光芒从天机录中激射而出，在陈机面前凝聚成一个巨大的眼眸——天道之眼的投影，再次降临！"

text.content: That blood-red eye slowly rotated, its pupil reflecting countless stars and threads of destiny. Its gaze was like substance, fiercely piercing into the depths of Chen Ji's soul, bringing a tearing agony. Chen Ji grunted, yet forcibly swallowed the pain, only fine beads of sweat already appearing on his temples. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled beside him, its illusory form almost on the verge of collapse.

dialogue.content: "Waste." The Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice was ice-cold with no emotion whatsoever, like announcing an established fact, "The Tianji Record's fragment chose you, originally a grace bestowed upon the lowly creature. Yet you do not think of gratitude, but instead attempt to peek into heavenly secrets, to篡改命运..." That blood-red eye suddenly contracted, "Since that is the case, this seat shall reclaim this grace."

text.content: Before the words finished, a blood-red thunder descended from the sky, striking directly at Chen Ji's brow center. That thunder's speed was unbelievably fast, almost within a blink it was already at hand. However, just as it was about to touch Chen Ji, the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, forming a shield of light that barely blocked that thunder. A deafening roar exploded in the secret chamber, dense cracks appearing on the stone walls.

Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, the Tianji Record剧烈震颤 in his arms, as if struggling against that inexplicable force. His vision began to blur, countless嘈杂的低语声 ringing in his ears—that was the remnant souls of prophets throughout the ages within the Tianji Record crying out in anguish. Yet even in this situation, his eyes remained clear as water, calmly observing everything, rapidly recording all information into his mind.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." A hint of playfulness even appeared in the Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice, "The Tianji Record actually protects you so... it seems the secrets on you are even more than this seat imagined." That blood-red eye slowly rotated, "Fine, since the Tianji Record wishes to protect you, this seat shall give you a chance. Seven days later, on the night of the full moon, this seat shall personally receive your soul. If you can survive by then, it proves you still have value to exist; if you die... then it proves you are merely atrash that was eliminated."

text.content: The moment the words fell, that blood-red death prophecy like a brand fiercely branded into Chen Ji's soul depths. That was an indescribable agony, as if countless burning red-hot iron needles were shuttling through his Mental Sea, deeply carving words like "seven days later," "night of the full moon," "death by violence" into every inch of his soul. Chen Ji finally couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood, his body trembling violently, yet still clenched his teeth and stood, not falling.

dialogue.content: "Remember this brand,trash." The Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice gradually faded away, yet still carried irresistible majesty, "It will remind you of the date of death, and magnify your fear tenfold, a hundredfold... this is the price of manipulating destiny." The blood-red glow slowly dissipated, that terrifying eye also retreated into the void, only the lingering echo remaining in the secret chamber.

text.content: The secret chamber fell into darkness again, the candles having completely gone out, only the faint glow of the Tianji Record Fragment still stubbornly flickering. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping粗重 breath, blood continuously dripping from the corners of his mouth, forming a small pool of shocking bloodstain on the ground. He could feel that death brand deeply embedded in his soul, every heartbeat like striking the funeral bell of death.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul gathered with difficulty, his gaze at Chen Ji filled with guilt and heartache: "I'm sorry, child... I originally wished to take this secret forever into the grave, yet I didn't expect..." His voice trembled, "Your father faced the same prophecy back then, he ultimately chose... No, you cannot take the same path as him!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, on his pale face there was no fear or despair to be seen, instead a faint smile appeared. That smile appeared especially eerie amidst the bloodstains, yet also especiallycomposed. He wiped the blood from the corners of his mouth with his sleeve, his voice hoarse yet firm: "Seven days... enough." He slowly stood up, putting the Tianji Record back into his embrace, "If heaven wants to destroy me, I shall defy heaven. In this world, there has never been a true死局."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul watched this young背影, suddenly remembering that equally stubborn man from back then. His eyes flashed with tears, yet ultimately did not say more. Some things must be faced and chosen by Chen Ji himself. All he could do was guard by the side, giving guidance when needed—merely this. The secret chamber fell into momentary silence, only Chen Ji's heavy breathing echoing in the darkness.

text.content: Chen Ji quickly swept his gaze across the chaos around him—the scattered bloodstains on the ground, the dense cracks covering the stone walls, and the suffocating pressure from the Heavenly Eye still lingering in the air. Standing at the threshold was Su Qingyao's cold, frost-like figure.

Su Qingyao's gaze fell first on Chen Ji. Upon seeing his pallid face and the dried blood at the corner of his mouth, a flash of obvious shock and heartache flickered in those normally cold eyes. Her footsteps unconsciously quickened, closing the distance in three strides. She reached out to support him, but the moment her fingertips touched Chen Ji's arm, they trembled slightly—an unconscious caring that even she wasn't aware of.

The silence in the air grew heavy; only the residual oppressive aura in the corner of the secret chamber still silently bore witness to that thrilling confrontation. Her hand tightened slightly, knuckles whitening from the force—she was waiting, waiting for him to speak.

Just then, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms trembled violently once more. A stream of information surged into his Mental Sea like a tide—that was the message transmitted by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. He closed his eyes, taking several breaths to digest this information, then slowly opened them again, a trace of indescribable brilliance flickering in his gaze. "Senior Sister," his voice was abnormally calm, "if I were to say that I might die in seven days... would you believe it?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, trying to find any trace of jest, but found only bottomless calm. Who wants to kill you?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, only gently patted the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms. He raised his head, directly meeting Su Qingyao's eyes. "So I came here to settle my affairs."

text.content: Su Qingyao's eyes finally reddened. She didn't speak, only walking slowly to Chen Ji, reaching out those hands that usually only held swords, gently covering his hand. Her fingertips were cold, yet carried an indescribable tenderness. "Since Heaven wants to destroy you," her voice was very soft, as if afraid to shatter something, "then I'll walk this path with you. On the road to the Underworld, at least there will be company." A bitter smile curved her lips, "You wretch... I've finally found my chance to repay what I owe you."

The air in the secret chamber seemed to solidify. Chen Ji looked at this woman who had always been cold as frost, but now her eyes held a gentleness and determination never seen before. He suddenly felt a warm current surge in his chest—a long-forgotten feeling of being cared for. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but found his throat blocked by something.

"Senior sister..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, "You shouldn't have gotten involved." Su Qingyao hearing this, smiled gently, that smile like ice and snow first melting, carrying a breathtaking beauty: "Already involved, why talk about should or shouldn't?" She paused, her tone suddenly serious, "Chen Ji, I only ask you one thing—do you want to live?"

Chen Ji was silent for a moment. Su Qingyao's question seemed simple, yet it pointed directly to the deepest answer in his heart. Did he want to live? From atrash servant disciple to where he stood today, how many life-and-death struggles had he experienced? The Tianji Record gave him foresight of the future, but also bore him pressures and loneliness beyond imagination. Death prophecy, seven-day countdown, the Eye of Heavenly Way's threat... all of this reminded him that his existence itself was a miracle that should not be allowed.

"Yes." Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes burning with an unprecedented light, "I want to live. I still have many things unfinished—I must find my missing sister Chen Nian, I must弄清楚 the truth of my father's death, I must let those who treated me astrash know how wrong they were." His voice gradually became firm, "So... I will not wait passively for death."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao looked into this man's eyes and suddenly realized she had never truly seen him clearly. There was no fear or despair in those eyes as she had imagined—only a steady, terrifying confidence. This confidence reminded her of true powerhouses—facing desperation, they did not rage or beg, but calmly sought the method to break the situation. She suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of appreciation: "This is the Chen Ji I know. Come, let me take you to meet someone."

text.content: "Meet who?" Chen Ji slightly raised his brow. Su Qingyao turned and walked toward the secret chamber exit, saying as she walked: "My master, Ling Yuan." Chen Ji's footsteps paused for a moment, but quickly followed. Ling Yuan—the old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, Chen Xuan's previous generation inheritance candidate, the one the Tianji Record skipped. This name stirred countless waves in Chen Ji's mind. Su Qingyao seemed not to notice his unusualness, only continuing on her own: "Master's cultivation is unparalleled, his knowledge vast—perhaps he will have a way."

The two passed through the dim corridor and arrived at the moonlit open space outside the secret chamber. Tonight's moon was large and full, casting cold silver radiance, dyeing all surrounding scenery in a pale glow. Chen Ji looked up at that bright moon, and a strange feeling suddenly rose in his heart—in seven days on the night of the full moon, perhaps he would part forever with this moon, or perhaps he would welcome rebirth after it. The scales of fate were slowly tilting beneath his feet.

Just as the two were about to step out of the open space, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's怀 suddenly violently trembled. He abruptly stopped, his expression changing drastically. At the same time, Su Qingyao also sensed something, her hand already pressing on the sword at her waist. Yet at this moment, an ancient yet majestic voice rang from the void, exploding like thunder in both their ears: "Su'er, bringing him to see me... do you want your master to save his life?"

The moment the voice fell, a figure appeared凭空 in the center of the open space. It was an seemingly ordinary old man, wearing a simple blue robe, his expression kind yet authoritative. Yet Chen Ji felt an indescribable oppression emanating from the old man, that power like a deep sea, unfathomable. Ling Yuan—the old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect—had finally appeared before him in true form. The old man's gaze fell on Chen Ji, carrying complex emotions, as if examining a treasured object recovered after loss, yet also as if observing prey about to walk to its death.

"Interesting." A meaningful smile curved Ling Yuan's lips, that smile making Chen Ji feel a莫名 chill. The old man walked closer slowly, each step seeming to step on Chen Ji's heartstrings, bringing waves of dull echoes. "The Eye of Heavenly Way's death prophecy... seventy years ago, this seat also heard it once." Ling Yuan's voice suddenly turned low, "And that time, this seat chose to submit to heaven's will." His gaze was like a blade, stabbing directly at Chen Ji, "What about you,trash? What will you choose?"

Chen Ji felt the deep meaning within the old man's gaze, that was not merely observation but aprobing. He suddenly understood something—Ling Yuan had also faced the Eye of Heavenly Way's death prophecy seventy years ago, and that person chose to submit to heaven's will. What did this mean? Was it accepting fate obediently, or were there hidden reasons? Chen Ji's heartbeat slightly accelerated, yet his face maintained that composed, unruffled expression. He raised his head, meeting Ling Yuan's gaze, his voice calm yet firm: "The junior chooses... to defy fate and change destiny."

Hearing this, Ling Yuan's expression turned playful. He suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing in the vast night sky, carrying an inexplicable meaning: "Defy fate and change destiny? Easy words to say!" His laughter stopped abruptly, his gaze becoming sharp beyond measure, "Do you know what the price of defying fate is? Seventy years ago, Chen Xuan also said the same words... and his ending, you should be very clear!" Chen Xuan—that was Chen Ji's father, the man chosen by the Tianji Record yet ultimately falling. The old man's words were like a blade, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's heart.

Chen Ji fell silent. Mo Xiansheng had not told him the details of his father Chen Xuan's fate, only saying he "chose his own path." Now hearing these words from Ling Yuan, he suddenly felt a bone-deep chill. The price of defying heaven to change fate might be crueler than he imagined. Yet just as he sank into contemplation, a clear sword cry suddenly pierced the night sky, followed by a sharp sword qi directly slashing toward Ling Yuan!

dialogue.content: "Master!" Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, her long sword already drawn, its blade radiating a biting cold light. "If you're trying to intimidate him, don't blame your disciple for being disrespectful!" Her eyes blazed with unprecedented fury—the rage of one whose reverse scale has been touched. Ling Yuan paused briefly, then a knowing smile spread across his face: "Oh? Su'er, could it be... you've fallen in love?"

text.content: Su Qingyao's face flushed slightly, yet she maintained her sword-wielding stance without yielding an inch. She knew her actions might provoke her master, but she didn't care. From childhood, she had buried her emotions deep within, wrapping herself in coldness and strength. Yet tonight, seeing Chen Ji's calm acceptance of death, something long sealed within her stirred awake. She would not allow anyone to harm him—even her own master, even heaven itself!

Ling Yuan收起笑容，改为dissipated his smile，his gaze sweeping between Su Qingyao and Chen Ji before dissolving into a meaningful sigh: "Very well, young people have their own fated connections." He turned away, his back to them both, his voice suddenly dropping low. "Chen Ji, I offer you a chance. On the seventh night when the moon is full, await me at Tianji Pavilion. If you can answer three questions, I shall reveal to you... how Chen Xuan defied heaven." With those words, the old man's silhouette vanished into the night.

Only Chen Ji and Su Qingyao remained on the open ground. Moonlight bathed them both, stretching their shadows long across the earth. Chen Ji turned to Su Qingyao, a faint smile curving his lips: "Senior Sister, that sword strike of yours startled me." Su Qingyao shot him a glare, sheathing her blade with a cold hmp h. "Serves you right for not fighting back when being bullied. You deserved to be frightened." Despite her sharp words, a subtle blush colored her ears, luminous beneath the moon's glow.

Observing Su Qingyao's flushed ears, an unexpected warmth stirred within Chen Ji. This woman who had always presented an icy exterior had drawn her sword for him tonight. Even facing her own master, even knowing the potential consequences, she had acted without hesitation. This sensation... caused a crack to form in Chen Ji's long-sealed heart. He drew a steadying breath and spoke quietly: "Senior Sister, thank you." Three simple words, yet they carried the weight of countless unspoken feelings.

Su Qingyao didn't turn around, her voice barely above a whisper: "Don't mention it. I simply didn't wish to watch an acquaintance die." Her tone remained cool, yet it lacked the distance of former times. Under the moonlight, the two stood side by side, their shadows intertwining as if fate's threads had already bound them tightly together. The seven-day countdown began from this very moment. Chen Ji knew that every day ahead would be a heart-pounding life-and-death game. If heaven sought his destruction, then he would defy heaven—this path would be solitary and perilous, yet it would undoubtedly forge his own legend.
